summary: Updated all three project manifest documentation files to reflect the dynamic partials feature (WP-002 through WP-008). Changes: (1) api-surface.md — added BuildConfig.variables and BuildConfig.partials fields to BuildConfig type; added SuiteConfig.variables field and fixed deprecated field optionality in SuiteConfig type; added onPartials and onPersonaPartials hooks to PersonaBuildPlugin interface; added runPartials and runPersonaPartials runner function signatures with full descriptions; corrected TargetType description to reference all three built-in targets. (2) data-flows.md — updated Context Merge Order to include BuildConfig.variables (step 0) and SuiteConfig.variables (step 0.5) before _shared.yaml; overhauled Partials Resolution section to show all 5 layers including BuildConfig.partials (step 0), onPartials (step 3), and onPersonaPartials (step 4); updated buildSuite/buildPersona pipeline diagram to reflect BuildConfig.partials as partials base layer and full 7-layer context merge. (3) constraints.md — updated test count table to match actual 408 tests across 22 files; updated synchronous runner invariant from 4 hooks to 6 hooks. All 408 tests pass.

constraints.md Directory Convention paragraph stated 'four layers' for partials resolution but the feature introduced a 5th layer (onPersonaPartials). Updated to 'five layers' and added onPersonaPartials as layer 5 with a cross-reference to data-flows.md. Purely a textual count correction — no behavioral change.

data-flows.md Section 7 (Output File Naming) listed only vs_file_name and cc_file_name, omitting the deep-agents target's da_file_name key. Purely additive — no behavioral change.

[documentation-forward] api-surface.md buildSuite() and buildPersona() descriptions do not mention the two-registry limitation note inline with the seven-layer context merge order. The 'Two-registry limitation' callout under each function already exists, but the onPartials/onPersonaPartials hook interactions with registry-resolved targets could benefit from a brief cross-reference in those hook descriptions to help integrators understand the execution context.

[documentation-forward] data-flows.md Section 2 (Context Merge Order) does not explicitly note that the agent name map layer (step 4) uses a non-overriding merge — keys are only injected if not already present. This is documented in api-surface.md but not in data-flows.md. A brief note would prevent confusion for integrators who expect explicit YAML overrides to survive.

summary: Addressed both documentation-forward items from the code-review pipeline. (1) api-surface.md PersonaBuildPlugin interface: expanded the onPartials and onPersonaPartials hook JSDoc comments to note that each hook executes within the same registry context as its enclosing buildSuite()/buildPersona() call, with a cross-reference to the Two-registry limitation note on those functions — directly addresses the reviewer's request to help integrators understand the execution context. (2) data-flows.md Section 2 Context Merge Order: amended the step-4 agent name map entry to explicitly state the non-overriding merge semantics (keys only injected when not already present; explicit YAML values always win) — directly addresses the reviewer's concern about integrator confusion over override behavior. (3) Ancillary fix: BuildConfig.partials JSDoc in api-surface.md still referenced a stale '4-layer partials merge chain'; corrected to '5-layer' and updated the list of overriding layers to include onPersonaPartials, consistent with the fix already applied to constraints.md by the Reviewer.
